title: Emergency crews on scene of 'major traffic accident' in Stillwater, fire department says

 Updated: 12:01 PM CST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jonathan Greco Digital Media Manager STILLWATER, Okla. — The Stillwater Fire Department says emergency crews are at the scene of a "major traffic accident" on Wednesday. 
 >> Open the video player above to see some of the headlines KOCO 5 is following. 
 Advertisement Authorities said the incident happened at West Sixth Avenue and Redlands Road. The nature of the "major traffic accident" has not been released, and fire department officials did not say whether anyone was injured. 
 Stillwater Fire Department officials said people should use caution while traveling in the area. People also are asked to watch for emergency personnel and allow crews room to work safely. 
 KOCO 5 will provide more details as they become available.
